As a commissioned officer on a school campus, you will patrol interior and exterior areas, respond to incidents, maintain de-escalation standards, and report daily activities to school admins and law enforcement.

jobs.title: Flexible-Shift Armed/Unarmed Protection Officer
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is seeking a Custom Protection Officer (CPO) Flex Officer to conduct armed and/or unarmed patrols at various assignments in Texas. Responsibilities include monitoring CCTV, access control, reporting, and deterring misconduct.

This role may require irregular shifts with little notice and offers weekly pay at $21.50 per hour. Ideal candidates possess a high school diploma and relevant security or law enforcement experience; armed positions require necessary licensing.

jobs.title: Flexible Security Pro - Varied Shifts, Growth & Pay
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is seeking a Security Professional Flex Officer to serve and safeguard clients across multiple industries, including Healthcare, Education and Finance. You’ll use our shift-pickup platform to view and claim open shifts based on your availability, gaining varied site experience while building a flexible schedule.

You will receive $20.00 per hour with weekly pay, and access to training and growth opportunities.
